content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for SCTIMST Senior Project Associate Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Senior Project Associate post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Senior Project Associate position at SCTIMST is scheduled for 05 October 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue on time with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Project Associate role?
faq.answer: The required qualification is a Masters degree in Yogic Sciences, or a Bachelors degree in Naturopathy and Yogic Sciences / BAMS with a Master's in Public Health (MPH), or an MD in Yoga / Ayurveda from a recognized University.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Senior Project Associate position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Project Associate post is 40 years as of 01 October 2026. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Senior Project Associate post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 42,000/- per month, plus 18% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Project Associate post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Senior Project Associate position at SCTIMST.

faq.question: Q7. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The job is contractual in nature, with the current duration ending on 28 January 2027.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if applicable), and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute for Medical Sciences and Technology (SCTIMST), Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, 695012.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will primarily involve a Walk-In-Interview. A Written Test may also be conducted, which will be of a qualifying nature.
